description: A painterly scene of a tall wooden lattice derrick with a black wellhead spewing dark liquid and dripping oil, with smoke rising behind it. Two men stand in the foreground looking up at the well: one bearded, in a dark turban and rough tunic, the other in a pith helmet and khaki shirt. Rocky, dry hills and a dusky sky fill the background. The image is dark and warm-toned, with no visible text, border or frame, and nothing graphic.
